description: This PHP file defines a trait 'LDAPConnectionHelperTrait' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Tests\LDAP'. It provides helper methods related to LDAP server configuration, including checking if the LDAP server is configured, retrieving the LDAP server configuration, and defining the configuration file path. The trait relies on external classes and libraries such as 'LDAPServerConfig' and 'Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml'.

methods.name: isLDAPServerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the LDAP server configuration file exists and is accessible, indicating LDAP is configured.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfig
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server configuration object, parsing the YAML configuration file if not already loaded.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the LDAP server configuration YAML file.
